t: Using Websockets to Stream Incremental Markdown
s: This article explores streaming Markdown responses from AI models in real-time web applications using Python's FastHTML, HTMX, and WebSockets. It highlights the challenge of parsing and rendering Markdown incrementally, emphasizing stateful parsing and the need for generating Markdown from the start rather than retroactively.
sub: Stateful Markdown Parsing and Incremental Rendering
Techniques and Libraries for Streaming Markdown (NLUX, streaming-markdown)
